title: Value preserved by restricting predicates
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game, let $T$ be a sign tester whose predicates all belong to a finite set $\Psi$ of sign predicates, and let $M$ be a positive integer. For every assignment of signs to pairs consisting of a vertex-query pair and a clone index, the value of the cloned long-code experiment restricted to $\Psi$ equals the value of the unrestricted cloned long-code experiment.
hypotheses_covered: A finite set $\Psi$ of sign predicates
Every predicate used by the tester belongs to $\Psi$
An assignment from vertex-query pairs and clone indices to signs
